# Humanizer

Unmodified `SKILL.md` and MIT license from https://github.com/blader/humanizer.
Pinned upstream commit: `9862685f575c65a8247f90369951df1b3416e3d6` (skill v3.0.0).

The social-copy generator reads the complete skill into every generation and
repair prompt, in embedded mode. It does not need a network fetch at runtime.
To update, replace both upstream files from one reviewed commit and update this
reference and `HUMANIZER_REVISION` in `backend/social_copy.py`.
